描述_EN: altar table frontal; silk tapestry (kesi) woven in coloured silks, gold thread and peacock feathers. the flap has a design of two phoenixes amid clouds confronting a gold sun, on a brick red background. the silks are in shades of red, tan, brown, and dark brown, sky blue, pale green, indigo and grey. the sky is filled with bold cloud motifs and auspicious emblems on a gold background. the design of a large facing four-clawed dragon with parts of face, scales in the body and claws is woven partially with peacock feather-embellished yarns. beneath are the waves with a small rock outcrop in the centre and mountains emerging at each side. the frontal is lined with a broad, cloud-figured, yellow silk damask.
描述_ZN: altar table frontal; silk tapestry (kesi) woven in coloured silks, gold thread and peacock feathers. 翻盖上有两只凤凰在云中与金色的太阳对峙的图案，背景为砖红色。 丝绸的色调有红色、棕褐色、棕色和深褐色、天蓝色、淡绿色、靛蓝色和灰色。 天空中充满了大胆的云彩图案和金色背景上的吉祥纹饰。 图案是一条巨大的面向四爪的龙，有脸部的部分，身体的鳞片和爪子，部分是用孔雀羽毛装饰的纱线织成的。 下面是波浪，中间有一个小岩石，两边有山峰出现。 正面的内衬是宽大的、有云纹的、黄色的丝绸锦缎。
